_doc: EEGDex manifest — NEW node (Muse EEG), per SIGNAL-ADAPTER brief Phase 3 (manifest-as-single-source). Carries the Phase-3 additions `evidence` (5-level ladder) + `goodDirection` per metric so codegen/dex-registry-gen.js projects eegdex-registry.js from ONE source. EEG is a genuinely new signal type — the adapter layer standardizes its INGEST; this manifest is the metric/grade source, not the DSP. Maturity is stated as dated prose in `warning` (rendered), never as a status enum — the `status` field was retired 2026-09-20.
description: Band-power and sleep-architecture analysis from consumer EEG (Muse). Direct spectral readouts, EEG-staged hypnogram, and derived micro-architecture markers.
warning: EEGDex is a scaffold, not a shipped node — as of 2026-09-20 a DSP module and its selftest exist, but no EEGDex app, bundle or hand-authored registry is built, and the adapter layer routes EEG files to an EEGDSP that resolves to undefined in every shipped bundle. This guide documents the manifest's intended metrics, not measured behaviour. Consumer dry-electrode EEG (4-channel Muse) has higher artifact rates and lower spatial resolution than clinical PSG. Contact quality gates every downstream metric.

fields.eeg: Float32Array[ch] — µV, 256 Hz, 4 channels (TP9, AF7, AF8, TP10)
fields.timestamps: Float64Array — floating wall-clock ms per sample (Clock Contract)

sections.title: Signal & Contact
sections.description: Direct signal-quality readouts that gate everything downstream

metrics.name: Contact Quality
metrics.fullName: Fraction of the recording with all electrodes in good contact
metrics.cite: Per-channel contact quality — direct sensor readout

metrics.name: Analyzable
metrics.fullName: Fraction of the recording usable after artifact rejection
metrics.cite: Analyzable coverage after artifact rejection — direct

metrics.name: Total Spectral Power
metrics.fullName: Broadband EEG power over (0, 45] Hz, the band the transform sums
metrics.cite: Broadband spectral power — direct from the PSD

sections.title: Band Powers
sections.description: Relative power in the canonical EEG bands

metrics.name: Relative Delta
metrics.fullName: Delta-band ([0.5, 4) Hz) relative power, as the engine bands it
metrics.formula: median over epochs with a spectrum of P([0.5, 4) Hz) / Σ P(f) over (0, 45] Hz
metrics.cite: Relative delta power — established EEG band readout

metrics.name: Relative Theta
metrics.fullName: Theta-band ([4, 8) Hz) relative power, as the engine bands it
metrics.formula: median over epochs with a spectrum of P([4, 8) Hz) / Σ P(f) over (0, 45] Hz
metrics.cite: Relative theta power — established EEG band readout

metrics.name: Relative Alpha
metrics.fullName: Alpha-band ([8, 12) Hz) relative power, as the engine bands it
metrics.formula: median over epochs with a spectrum of P([8, 12) Hz) / Σ P(f) over (0, 45] Hz
metrics.cite: Relative alpha power — established EEG band readout

metrics.name: Relative Sigma
metrics.fullName: Sigma-band ([12, 16) Hz) relative power, as the engine bands it
metrics.formula: median over epochs with a spectrum of P([12, 16) Hz) / Σ P(f) over (0, 45] Hz
metrics.cite: Relative sigma power — established EEG band readout, a band share and never a spindle count

metrics.name: Relative Beta
metrics.fullName: Beta-band ([16, 30) Hz) relative power, as the engine bands it
metrics.formula: median over epochs with a spectrum of P([16, 30) Hz) / Σ P(f) over (0, 45] Hz
metrics.cite: Relative beta power — established EEG band readout

metrics.name: Alpha/Theta Ratio
metrics.fullName: Ratio of alpha to theta band power
metrics.formula: median over epochs with nonzero theta power of P([8, 12) Hz) / P([4, 8) Hz)
metrics.cite: Alpha/theta ratio — published drowsiness/relaxation index, device-dependent

metrics.name: REM Fraction
metrics.fullName: Fraction of total sleep time scored REM from EEG
metrics.cite: EEG-staged REM fraction — EEG is the sleep-staging reference standard

metrics.name: Spindle Density
metrics.fullName: Sleep-spindle count per minute of N2
metrics.cite: Sleep-spindle density (11–16 Hz bursts) — published memory-consolidation marker, device-dependent

metrics.name: Frontal Alpha Asymmetry
metrics.fullName: ln(α right) − ln(α left) over frontal channels (AF7/AF8)
metrics.cite: Frontal alpha asymmetry — affective-state composite, EEGDex-derived, weak consumer-grade support

metrics.name: Calm Score
metrics.fullName: Composite relaxation index blended from band ratios
metrics.formula: weighted blend of α/θ, β suppression, and stability
metrics.cite: Calm score — heuristic wellness composite, not a validated EEG metric

metrics.name: Hypnogram
metrics.fullName: Per-epoch sleep-stage series scored from one EEG channel
metrics.cite: Single-channel band-power staging — literature-backed, not PSG-validated (EEGDEX-BUILD-BRIEF §0)

metrics.name: Total Sleep Time
metrics.fullName: Hours of epochs scored N1, N2, N3 or REM
metrics.cite: Total sleep time from the staged hypnogram — it inherits the stager tier, never the clock tier

metrics.name: Sleep Efficiency
metrics.fullName: Percent of SCORED epochs that are sleep, not of the recording span
metrics.cite: Sleep efficiency over the scored population — an unscorable epoch is excluded, never counted as wake

metrics.name: N3 Fraction
metrics.fullName: Fraction of total sleep time scored N3, the slow-wave share
metrics.cite: N3 fraction from the staged hypnogram — single-channel stager, not a PSG score
